### workspace lookup --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace lookup <path|branch|project>

Find a workspace project by worktree path, branch name, or project key.

Arguments:
  /path/to/.worktrees/pr-21291   Worktree directory path
  pr-21291                       Branch name or project key
  AIKYA-389-skip-validation      Full branch name

Returns the workspace project name if found, or exits with status 1 if not found.

Examples:
  workspace lookup ~/src/api    # which workspace has this directory as its root
  workspace lookup ~/src/api/lib    # a directory inside a project's root resolves to that project
  workspace lookup PROJ-1876-use-lock-version    # which workspace is on this branch
  workspace lookup api    # does a project by this name exist (exit status 1 if not)
--- stderr
--- end
